name: The Citadel (Cetate)
tagline: Living inside a medieval UNESCO fortress
description: The upper walled town is Sighisoara's postcard heart: cobbled lanes, pastel guild houses, defensive towers, and the landmark Clock Tower. Staying here means history on your doorstep and a short walk to every sight, balanced against tourist crowds, steep cobbles, and premium prices at the cafes and restaurants within the walls.
bestFor: Slow-travel nomads who want to wake up inside the storybook citadel
pros: Steps from the Clock Tower, museums, and main squares
Genuinely unique, photogenic place to live
cons: Tourist crowds and higher cafe and restaurant prices
Steep cobbles and stairs make daily errands a workout

name: Lower Town (Orasul de Jos)
description: Spread below the citadel along the Tarnava Mare river, the lower town is where locals actually live and shop. It holds the train and bus links, everyday supermarkets, cheaper eateries, and the weekly market, making it the practical, better-value base for a longer stay while the citadel sits a short climb above.
bestFor: Budget-minded nomads who want convenience and local prices
pros: More affordable rents and everyday shopping
Close to the train station and bus connections
Flatter ground and real local life
cons: Less charming and scenic than the citadel above
A short uphill walk to reach the main sights

name: Church on the Hill / Scholars' Stairs
tagline: The quiet, leafy top of the old town
description: At the citadel's highest point, reached by the covered wooden Scholars' Stairs, sit the Gothic Church on the Hill and its old cemetery. This pocket is calm, green, and dramatic, ideal for anyone who values peace and views, though the long climb and limited housing make it more a place to wander than to base yourself.
bestFor: Those craving quiet, greenery, and the best citadel views
pros: Sweeping views over the town and hills
The iconic covered Scholars' Stairs on your doorstep
cons: The steep, long stair climb gets old daily
Very limited housing and few amenities nearby

name: Cornesti
tagline: Residential outskirts with space and value
description: Cornesti is a residential area on Sighisoara's edge, made up of quieter streets, houses with gardens, and everyday local life away from the tourist core. It trades the citadel's charm for more space, lower prices, and calm, best suited to longer-stay nomads with a car or those content with a short trip into the center.
bestFor: Longer-stay nomads wanting space, calm, and lower costs
pros: Cheaper rents and more living space
Quiet, residential, away from tourist crowds
cons: Away from the sights and nightlife
A car or regular walks are needed to reach the center
